evidence_boundaries: The formal PRE result is an author 1D-3V EPOCH particle-tracking study and fractional-transport interpretation; it has no new experiment, suppresses transverse physics and does not publish its data.
The 100 Hz LWFA beam metrics come from 10,000 experimental shots, but 1 kHz and FLASH dose rates are projections; the best FBPIC fit uses 0.1% argon compared with 1% in the experiment.

The Ho/Tm measurements use a storage-ring laser-Compton gamma source, not a laser-plasma electron beam and high-Z converter; their value to that application chain is as nuclear-data and detector-model validation.

Photoneutron cross sections include neutron-plus-charged-particle final states, beam-spectrum unfolding and multiplicity sorting, while GDR/GQR assignments and quadrupole moments retain model dependence.
No EPOCH, FBPIC/LASY, PCA, spectral deconvolution, EMPIRE, TALYS, photon-spectrum unfolding, detector response, dose or shielding calculation was rerun locally.
